review_required_amendments.summary: Lean certificate identity and the frozen runtime object are not independently cryptographically bound.
The trusted evaluator does not enforce the complete frozen ValueTypeV1 metadata contract.

post_review_amendments.summary: Twenty-four required profile/source custody files were absent from the tested Git object.
post_review_amendments.repair: The 24 files were tracked byte-for-byte and v4 proved all 25 source-custody files were Git-tracked and hash-bound before and during isolation.

post_review_amendments.summary: Three authority attachment records required after exact verification were absent from the clean Git checkout, so v4 could not emit a complete result or bundle.
post_review_amendments.repair: Track the three pre-existing hash-matching authority records byte-for-byte and expand the clean-commit and in-namespace custody gate to the complete 28-file source-plus-authority runtime corpus.

post_review_amendments.summary: Two Python files already named and hash-bound in the frozen 73-file dependency closure were not Git objects, so a clean checkout did not contain the complete declared closure.
post_review_amendments.repair: Track both files byte-for-byte at their existing frozen hashes and require every path/hash pair in the frozen dependency manifest to be Git-tracked and rechecked before and during isolated qualification.
